description: This line plot compares the loss values of two models, “Vanilla” and “SepLLM,” as a function of computational cost measured in TFLOPs. The x-axis, labeled “TFLOPs,” spans from 0.00 to 1.25 × 10⁹ on a linear scale, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.25. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” ranges from 2.40 to 2.75 and is also on a linear scale. The “Vanilla” model is represented by a purple line with triangle markers and a dashed line style, starting at a loss of approximately 2.75 at 0.00 TFLOPs and decreasing to about 2.50 at 1.25 × 10⁹ TFLOPs. The “SepLLM” model is represented by a red line with circular markers and a solid line style, starting at a loss of approximately 2.75 at 0.00 TFLOPs and decreasing to about 2.46 at 1.25 × 10⁹ TFLOPs. A green dashed rectangle highlights the region between 1.00 and 1.25 × 10⁹ TFLOPs, with a green arrow and text indicating a 1.28× multiplier, suggesting a comparison of computational scaling. A horizontal green dashed line at a loss value of 2.50 intersects both lines near the 1.00 × 10⁹ TFLOPs mark.
